premises.text: Stores use opaque dynamic and personalized pricing that outmatches consumers, and price-drop/coupon guarantees are too complex and time-consuming for shoppers to claim
premises.evidence_span: Stores try to give people comfort around these fast-changing prices by offering a guarantee that if a price drops after you buy it or you miss a coupon, you can get this difference back. But it's a huge hassle

premises.text: A web app can capture purchases via inbox OAuth and account linking, track prices and coupons, check store policies, and NLP-file refund claims automatically
premises.evidence_span: It scans your inbox for receipts, tracks the prices on what you bought, and when they drop, automatically files claims to get you paid

premises.text: Receipt and store-communication data can be pulled and secured without reading other email contents
premises.evidence_span: We placed customized webhooks to pull receipts and store communications based on subject and sender alone, without ever touching the contents of your other emails

premises.text: Coverage of the largest online retailers is sufficient for typical shopping categories
premises.evidence_span: Paribus already supports 20 of the largest stores online

premises.text: Monetization is a success fee charged only after savings are delivered (25%, reducible via referrals)
premises.evidence_span: The only time that Paribus earns is after we save you money first. Our standard fee is charged 25% of the money we earn you

value.text: Consumers recover money owed from post-purchase price drops effortlessly
value.evidence_span: gets you the money you're owed effortlessly

causal_links.evidence_span: online consumers are leaving $10 billion on the table every year
no matter where you shop or what you're buying, food, electronics, clothing, books, you name it, Paribus has you covered

notes: Pain-side dynamic pricing plus claim hassle folded as one problem set (v1.5.1 §4.1.6). Receipt-to-claim pipeline kept as one mechanism cascade (§4.1.7); security treated as separately asserted trust condition. Beta savings counts and member traction excluded per §4.2. Anti-template: D1/D2/D3 map to problem, product, and commercial coverage/fee as separately revisable modules named in the pitch.
